title: Unit Event — Perspective for Smile — Episode7 Perspectives

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has finished training with Shunmeiza, and is set to study stage combat with the Mikazukigumi troupe. How will Emu and the others fare on this new, intensely physical stage?!

rows.Line: Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (See things from other people's perspectives...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Then, my portrayal of Ushiwakamaru will become a lot better.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But I don't have a lot of time until the day our acting skills are put to the test. Which means I can't do what Mr. Kijima did...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Then...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I just have to come up with a way to make it so everyone understands what my character is feeling!)
<Emu!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
That sounded like...
<Over here, Emu!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Len!
What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Well, I've become really good at doing those squats you showed us the other day, so I was wondering if we could do some together...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wait, huh...?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Is there something on your mind right now?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? How did you know?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Because the space between your eyebrows is all squished and wrinkly.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Is something bothering you?
I wanna help if I can!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe. Thanks, Len!
Then, if you don't mind listening for a bit...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Today, Mr. Kijima told me that...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <...seeing things from other people's perspectives, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, and I was trying to come up with a way to learn how to do that in a short amount of time...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <In that case, the answer's easy...!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Lemme help you!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I'll watch you practice your lines as much as need me to. Dozens or hundreds of times if necessary. And I'll tell you what I think!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<And I'm probably not alone.
I bet KAITO, Miku, Tsukasa and everyone else will wanna help too...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<No, not just them.
I have a feeling that a lot of other people will also want to help.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Why don't you try asking everyone around you to see if they'll watch you practice for just a bit and hear what they have to say...?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That should at least be a little similar to what Mr. Kijima did!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehe. He's right...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I have all these people around me who I can ask for help!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
If I ask everyone I know for their help, then my acting should get a super duper amazingly awesome boost of power!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I'm gonna start right now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
By asking you first, Len!
Could you watch me practice for a little bit?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, sure!>

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll be going now.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Okay, good luck.
Oh, do you think you'll be home in time for dinn—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shooosuuuke!
se_run_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Whoa, why are you shouting so early in the morning? What is it you want today?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, I wanna ask you guys for a favor!
But you don't have to help me right this second. Whenever you're free is fine...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: A favor?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We don't want to be late, so please make it quick.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks!
So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “So, shall we go stir things up in this world a little?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...and scene!
How'd I do?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I knew you'd give us a good performance!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I really don't know much about acting, but you just want us to say what we felt, right...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, please tell me!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So, I thought it'd be better if you jumped around a lot more to really show how excited Ushiwakamaru is!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <He has a lot of fun while fighting against Benkei, right? That's why I think he'd move around with a lot more energy!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hmm... But wouldn't that sort of take away from Ushiwakamaru's cool and collected demeanor?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I agree.
During this scene, Ushiwakamaru's probably feeling a sense of fun, but not just that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, that boy's looking our way!
Sorry, everyone, but you're all going to have to hide for the time being!
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hello there. Is something wrong?
Where are your mommy and daddy? Are they not here with you?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
They're over there.
I came to get my ball...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Your ball?
Oh, this?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sorry for not noticing sooner.
We didn't realize that it'd come our way.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Anyway, what were you guys doing just now?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I saw some of you jumping around while shouting “Hiyah!” and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We're practicing for a play!
It's about this amazing person who lived a really long time ago called Ushiwakamaru!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: A play...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, do you want to see it...?!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Yeah, kinda...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
Oh, in that case...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wanna watch us rehearse our play?!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Wait, you mean it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! How about it, you guys...?
I know we don't have all the people we need, but let's try to figure something out...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I don't mind.
Plus, it's also two birds with one stone in terms of hearing from as many different people as you can.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good point! Then, it's time for Wonderlands×Showtime to put on a surprise performance!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Before we do, we might want to ask his parents first. We probably shouldn't just suddenly start performing for him without their permission...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, we should ask to see if they'd also like to watch. We are trying to hear from as many people as we can, after all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Okay, my phone has everything on video...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Now I need to see how I looked through everyone else's eyes as I performed today!)

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: “Hup.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The final scene where I fight Benkei...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm supposed to show just how much fun Ushiwakamaru's having. He's so excited by how beautiful the moon is on this night, and...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (As Benkei tries to fight him, he starts to really enjoy teasing his opponent.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I have to make sure I do that mischievous side of Ushiwakamaru justice...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Huh...?
But everyone's watching me so seriously...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (No, this can't be right...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Everyone's supposed to be giggling and snickering as they watch...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Oh, I know...!
What if I did something more...?)
